units.source_text: 可就在我萌發這種想法的時候，堀木又出現在我眼前。

en.t: But just as that thought began to stir in me, Horiki appeared before me again.
Well now, you have changed quite a bit.

units.source_text: 我今天可是來幫高円寺那位女士傳話的啊。」

en.t: Today I have come to deliver a message from that lady in Koenji.

units.source_text: 剛一開口，他突然壓低嗓門，用下巴指了指正在廚房沏茶的良子，對我說：「沒關係吧？」

en.t: As soon as he began, he suddenly lowered his voice, gestured with his chin toward Yoshiko making tea in the kitchen, and said to me, "Is it all right?"
It is all right. Say whatever you like.

units.source_text: 事實上，良子可稱得上是信賴人的天才，

en.t: In fact, Yoshiko could almost be called a genius at trusting people,

units.source_text: 別說是我和京橋小酒館老闆娘之間的事，

en.t: not only about what had happened between me and the proprietress of the little bar in Kyobashi,

units.source_text: 就算是告訴了她在鎌倉發生的那件事，

en.t: even if I told her about that incident in Kamakura,

units.source_text: 她也不會懷疑我與常子的關係。

en.t: she still would not have suspected my relationship with Tsuneko.
